## Reaper Control 2.0.0

The first release of the rewrite: a stage app that plays a REAPER setlist live, hands over from song to song on time, and stays out of the way. A native REAPER extension runs the show, so a crash or restart of the app never interrupts playback.

### Playing a set
- **Setlists** live in the REAPER project itself. Create, rename, delete, reorder and select them in the app; the app keeps a restore copy.
- **Hand-over** from one song to the next at the end of the song, with no gap and no jump. Pause and Play work during a hand-over.
- **Hard stop** with the `!1008` marker (or `!hardstop`): the set stops at the end of the song, and Play goes into the next song. It also works when REAPER itself (SWS) stops at the marker earlier: the timeline runs on to the end of the song.
- **Song directives** in markers: `!length:N` and `!bpm:N`, combinable with the hard stop.
- **Count-in** when jumping to a cue, using REAPER's own count-in. **Auto-resume playback**, the record-arm toggle, next, previous and restart song.
- **Click the timeline** to seek, with a time bubble; a click near a cue snaps to it. Cue and hard stop tooltips on the timeline.
- **Click a song** to jump to its start: it stays on that song, also when the song before ends exactly where it begins.
- **Several projects:** the app follows the active REAPER project tab.

### Performer screen
- Big song title, song time and time left, set time elapsed and remaining, the next song and its length, the hard stop prompt, the clock, the record dot and the toggles.

### Control
- **Keyboard:** Space, the arrow keys and `a`.
- **MIDI pads and controllers:** device selection with hot-plug, channel filter and note mapping.

### Help
- A Help screen with setup, songs, special markers, count-in and MIDI, and a box to try a marker name: type `Song A !length:45 !1008` and see how the app reads it.

### Connection and install
- **First-run setup wizard** finds REAPER, installs the matching extension, asks for a restart and waits until the link is up. The Settings connection card can repair it later.
- **Loopback link** with a token between the extension and the app. No REAPER web interface and no script is needed.
- **Safe mode:** if REAPER did not shut down cleanly, the extension starts disabled and the app says so. See the known issues.
- **Diagnostics:** log files, a journal of every performance event, a system stats dialog (CPU, memory, link latency), and "Export diagnostics" in Settings.

### Platforms
- macOS on Apple Silicon (arm64) and Windows x64. Tested with REAPER 7.82.

### Known issues
- After a REAPER crash the extension stays disabled until you remove the `faulted` and `running` files in the `RC2` folder of the REAPER resource path (Windows: `%APPDATA%\REAPER\RC2`). The app has no re-enable button yet.
- The app is not code-signed (see below).
